response: {"texts": [{"id": "DMSR-2624", "text": null}, {"id": "DMSR-1031", "text": null}, {"id": "OSS-REQ-0057", "text": "The DMS shall provide software for User Interface Services, including services to: browse LSST data products through astronomical views or visualizations; create and serve ”best” images of selectable regions of the sky; resample and re-project images, and visualize catalog content."}, {"id": "OSS-REQ-0041", "text": "The DMS shall contain a component that, at each Center, can initialize the DM Subsystem into a well-deﬁned safe state when powered up."}, {"id": "OSS-REQ-0307", "text": "The DMS shall contain a component that, at each Center, can initialize the DM Subsystem into a well-deﬁned safe state when powered up."}, {"id": "OSS-REQ-0178", "text": "The DMS shall provide software to enable bulk download of data products and raw data, subject to network bandwidth."}, {"id": "OSS-REQ-0180", "text": "The DMS shall provide a service for Image Access through community data access protocols, to support programmatic search and retrieval of images or image cut-outs."}, {"id": "OSS-REQ-0044", "text": "The DMS shall contain a component to control all Level-1 Data Product production."}, {"id": "OSS-REQ-0037", "text": null}, {"id": "OSS-REQ-0038", "text": "The DMS shall provide software to orchestrate execution of productions, including deploying pipelines on a computing platform."}, {"id": "OSS-REQ-0034", "text": "The DMS shall provide software to monitor execution of pipelines in real time."}]}
